what: Gumbel-max device sampler, TV distance against its bootstrap floor, across five independent seeds
why: A single seed cannot distinguish a correct sampler from a lucky one. The gate's verdict was hostage to one draw, and the historical 0.1064 was read as quality when it was one sample of a scattered quantity.
rng: SFPU RNG with #52024 correlation fix; per-core separation via rand_tile_init(seed, stream_id)
note: The target distribution is regenerated per seed, so the bootstrap floor moves with it. Each row must be read against its own floor, not a shared one.

summary.verdict: PASS across all five. TV scatters around the floor mean rather than sitting under it, which is what a correctly-distributed sampler looks like.

what_this_does_not_show: It does not show that stream_id beats the host-side 7919 stride it replaced. Both schemes' single-run numbers fall inside this spread, so the sweep cannot separate them. stream_id is preferred because it is the hardware's own mechanism with a known-equidistributed constant (2^32/phi), not because it measured better.
